for (const [t, label] of [[0.5, 'hook'], [1.9, 'long'], [2.9, 'punch'], [3.7, 'check']]) {\n    window.applyFrame(Math.round(t * 30), 120);\n    const spans = beatEl.getElementsByClassName('w');\n    let x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y0 = 1e9, y1 = -1e9, n = 0, txt = [];\n    for (const s of spans) {\n      const r = s.getBoundingClientRect();\n      if (r.width === 0) continue;\n      x0 = Math.min(x0, r.left); x1 = Math.max(x1, r.right);\n      y0 = Math.min(y0, r.top); y1 = Math.max(y1, r.bottom); n++; txt.push(s.textContent);\n    }\n    out.push({ label, words: n, fontSize: getComputedStyle(beatEl).fontSize, x0: Math.round(x0), x1: Math.round(x1), y0: Math.round(y0), y1: Math.round(y1), text: txt.join(' ') });\n  }\n  return out;\n});\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify(bounds,
